thread.title: Apple, suppliers drop on talks of tariff impact - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Apple, suppliers drop on talks of tariff impact - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
President Trump’s tariff list covers some Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) products, according to a CNBC source .
Apple had sent a letter to the government saying the proposed tariffs would affect the Apple Watch, AirPods, and Apple Pencil.
Apple shares closed today down 0.8% to $221.30.
Suppliers Skyworks (NASDAQ: SWKS ), and Cirrus Logic (NASDAQ: CRUS ) closed down 1.3% and 2.3% , respectively.
